name: Read info
summary: Utility that writes the measurement info (channels, sampling rate, filters and other metadata) of an MNE epochs file to a text file for inspection.
description: Loads epoched MEG/EEG data with mne.read_epochs and writes str(epochs.info) to info.txt, also showing it in the brainlife process view. Use it to check recording metadata without downloading the data. It reads no parameters.

outputs.description: Text file (info.txt) with the epochs' info structure.

citations.text: Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7(267):1-13 (2013).
